seo.title: Privacy Policy - DevToolHive
seo.description: All tools process data locally. No upload, no registration. Read our privacy policy.

sections.heading: 1. Local Browser Processing
sections.text: All tools run entirely in your browser. We do not transmit, store, or process any data you input (text, images, files) on any server. Inputs never leave your device.

sections.heading: 2. Information We Do Not Collect
sections.text: We do not require registration or accounts. We do not collect personal data such as names, emails, or addresses. We do not store your tool inputs or outputs.

sections.heading: 3. Cookies and Google AdSense
sections.text: We use Google AdSense to display ads. Google and its partners may use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits. You can opt out of personalized advertising at Google's Ads Settings.

sections.heading: 4. Consent Mode v2
sections.text: We implement Google Consent Mode v2. On first visit you can Accept or Reject non-essential cookies. Your choice is stored locally in your browser.

sections.heading: 5. Third-Party Links
sections.text: Our site may contain links to third-party sites. We are not responsible for their privacy practices.

sections.heading: 6. Children's Privacy
sections.text: Our site is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect information from children.

sections.heading: 7. Changes to This Policy
sections.text: We may update this policy. Changes are posted on this page.

sections.heading: 8. Contact
sections.text: For privacy questions, contact us at the email listed in the footer.
